name: MonarchProgress
title: ProgressCircle
summary: A progress ring, determinate or indeterminate: MonarchProgress with variant = Circular.
whenToUse: For progress in a small area, such as a list row, a card or an upload tile; with a progress value when the fraction is known.
whenNotToUse: For progress across the width of a page or a step in a flow, use MonarchProgress with the Linear variant. Inside a button, use MonarchButton(loading = true).
api: @Composable fun MonarchProgress(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, progress: Float? = null, variant: MonarchProgressVariant = MonarchProgressVariant.Linear, label: String? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Accent, size: MonarchProgressSize = MonarchProgressSize.Md, showValue: Boolean = false)
enum class MonarchProgressSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the ring. A size here sets the diameter.

options.name: progress
options.description: The completed fraction from 0 to 1; null spins indeterminately. Clamped.

options.name: label
options.description: What is in progress, for TalkBack. Indeterminate without a label is named "Loading" (monarch_progress_loading); determinate without a label has no name.

options.name: tone
options.description: The color of the indicator: the accent, or a status tone for quotas and checks. Keep the meaning in text too.

options.name: size
options.description: The bar thickness (4, 8, 12dp) or ring diameter (24, 40, 64dp).

options.name: showValue
options.description: Writes the percentage after the bar or small ring, inside a large ring. Determinate only; read once, from the indicator.

states.name: determinate
states.description: The arc covers the completed fraction, clamped to 0 through 1.

states.name: indeterminate
states.description: An arc that turns; with animations removed in the system settings it does not move.

appearance: The arc is the solid accent color on a track in the emphasis background, in every theme. The Material 3 ring is 40dp across with a 4dp stroke.
platformNotes: No separate type: the web ProgressCircle is MonarchProgress with variant = Circular, as the plan expected. The web size (xs to xl), tone and showValue options are not offered by MonarchProgress today: the ring is the Material 3 size unless the modifier sets one, always in the accent color, and the value is not drawn in the middle; show it as text beside the ring. Adding those to MonarchProgress is a change to an existing component and is left for its owner. iOS ships a separate ring style, MonarchCircularProgressViewStyle. The web formatValue and locale options have no equivalent: TalkBack reads the fraction as a percentage in the device locale.
accessibility: A determinate ring is a progress bar with its fraction, which TalkBack reads as a percentage.
The label is the content description; an indeterminate ring without a label is named "Loading".
A determinate ring without a label has no name: give it one that says what is in progress.
Not a live region; announce the start and end of long work in text if it matters.
edgeCases: Values below 0 or above 1 are clamped.
The color is always the accent; a quota near its limit is not shown in the danger color, so say it in the label or beside the ring.

examples.title: Determinate
examples.template:
Row(
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
) {
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{rings.0.value}} / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = {{rings.0.label}},
        tone = {{rings.0.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{rings.0.size|pascal}},
        showValue = {{rings.0.showValue}},
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{rings.1.value}} / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = {{rings.1.label}},
        tone = {{rings.1.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{rings.1.size|pascal}},
        showValue = {{rings.1.showValue}},
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{rings.2.value}} / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = {{rings.2.label}},
        tone = {{rings.2.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{rings.2.size|pascal}},
        showValue = {{rings.2.showValue}},
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = {{rings.3.value}} / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = {{rings.3.label}},
        tone = {{rings.3.tone|tone}},
        size = MonarchProgressSize.{{rings.3.size|pascal}},
        showValue = {{rings.3.showValue}},
    )
}
examples.code:
Row(
    horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(MonarchTheme.spacing.space3),
    verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
) {
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 25 / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = "Upload",
        tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Sm,
        showValue = false,
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 60 / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = "Import",
        tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Md,
        showValue = false,
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 72 / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = "Sync",
        tone = MonarchTone.Accent,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Lg,
        showValue = true,
    )
    MonarchProgress(
        progress = 100 / 100f,
        variant = MonarchProgressVariant.Circular,
        label = "Backup",
        tone = MonarchTone.Success,
        size = MonarchProgressSize.Xl,
        showValue = true,
    )
}
